'''Redldr12 Yoda says 'mind what you have learned'''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Redldr12]]
* '''Published:''' 6 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 MWYHL Redldr12 LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

THIS IS MY ATTEMPT AT A JEDI TRAINING DECK.  WORKED WELL IN FUN PLAY BUT UNTESTED IN TOURNAMENT PLAY.  FEED BACK WOULD BE APPRECIATED.

== Strategy ==

THE STRATEGY OF THIS DECK IS TO JEDI TEST WITH LEIA BUT LUKE COULD BE USED.  WHILE LEIA TESTS ON DAGABOH I USE JEDI TO GO TO MY OPPONENT SITES OR THE BATTLE PLAINS TO DRAIN WITH LIGHT SABERS.  IF A BATTLE ENSUES MY LARGE AMOUNT OF JEDI DEAL WITH IT.  I HAVE HIGH DESTINES IN THIS DECK TO HELP WITH JEDI TESTS AND LIGHT SABER SWINGS.  THIS DECK HAS A TENDENCY TO DRAW A MAIN FOR BATTLE DESTINY WHEN MY OPPONENT DRAWS MULTIPLE 7’S.  TO COMBAT THAT I HAVE YOU DO HAVE YOUR MOMENTS TO CANCEL THE ATTRITION.  I’D LOVE FEED BACK ON THE DECK.  THANKS!

NOW LET ME EXPLAIN SOME OF THE INNTRUPTS I USE.

REBEL ARTILLERY IS GREAT FOR DESTINY AND IF HAN OR ADMIDALA GET A WEAPON OUT FOURCE LOSS.

LET THE WOOKIE WIN HAS AN ALL RGHT DESTINY AND IS EFFECTIVE IF CHEWIE SEE SOME ACTION.

PUT THAT DOWN IS A GREAT CARD TO STOP LIGHTSABER SWINGS ON MY MAINS.
